Speaker: Gao
Content: My father, you had been caught by the God <color=#FFDC88>Shu</color>.

Speaker: Gao
Content: My father, how can I find your trace?

Speaker: Gao
Content: Exactly. Dear fox, how do you know us?

Speaker: Fox
Content: Gao, the damage you two have caused to nature was so much!

Speaker: Fox
Content: You even violated the contract and captured the wild boar of the God Shu!

Speaker: Gao
Content: Well...but I don't think Shu has the right to catch my father.

Speaker: Fox
Content: Gao, your father is imprisoned on <color=#9876C5>the fifth hill</color>, and <color=#FFDC88>this</color> is the first one.

Speaker: Fox
Content: To <color=#6AADFF>reconcile</color> rather than continue to destroy nature, otherwise you will also fall into the same fate.

Speaker: Gao
Content: My father often said that, the south slope is sunny, the north valley is shady.

Speaker: Gao
Content: And all white things go up, all black things go down, that's the rule.

Speaker: Gao
Content: The snakes are twisting with each other, I can't pass through this way…

Speaker: Gao
Content: Well…the stones seem to be the next trouble.

Speaker: Gao
Content: If I go to resolve the dispute between these two snakes first, will I also find another way?

Speaker: Gao
Content: So many rocks, I'm definitely reaching the peak.
